decisions.PQA-U: excluded_from_mvp; it is unlabeled and no unsupervised experiment is planned for the first version.

datasets.name: PubMedQA
datasets.license_review: The repository license does not by itself establish rights for every underlying abstract or source record; verify applicable source terms before redistribution.
transformations: PQA-L only; source JSON order is retained for the upstream split protocol.
The upstream seed-0 500/500 holdout is reproduced; the CV half is grouped by source/content with seed 42 into train and validation.
Whitespace is normalized by the PubMedQA loader; PQA-A and PQA-U are not used.
datasets.notes: PQA-L is expert-labeled. The repository MIT license does not establish rights for every underlying abstract/source record; verify applicable source terms before redistribution. PQA-A is artificially generated and train-only if separately approved; PQA-U is unlabeled and excluded. Preserve the official evaluation half.

datasets.name: MedQuAD
datasets.license_review: Preserve attribution and source metadata. Follow the repository notice that answers are removed from three MedlinePlus-related subsets; do not reconstruct or crawl those answers without permission.
transformations: Pinned to repository revision 577bd37b96c02d1833b2c9eed2de9f96964e96cb; archive SHA-256 recorded.
Excluded the three MedlinePlus-related subsets named in the repository copyright notice.
Use only XML records with non-empty answers; preserve source URL, NIH source, question type, and focus.
datasets.notes: The official repository declares CC BY 4.0 and requests attribution. Its README says answers are removed from the three excluded subsets; no answers are reconstructed or crawled. Public educational content is not a hospital protocol.
